text: Hunter × Hunter is a Japanese manga series created by Yoshihiro Togashi. It began serialization in Weekly Shonen Jump in 1998 and has been released irregularly because of the author's health, but it has over thirty collected volumes.

The story follows a boy named Gon Freecss who grows up on Whale Island. He discovers that his father, Ging, is actually alive and is a famous Hunter, a licensed elite who takes on dangerous jobs around the world.

After learning the truth about his father, Gon decides to become a Hunter himself. He leaves his home island, determined to pass the Hunter Exam and eventually meet Ging to prove that he can follow the same path.

Hunters in this world are licensed professionals who can explore unknown places, track rare creatures, search for treasures, or chase criminals. The Hunter License gives them many privileges, such as access to restricted areas and valuable information.

During the Hunter Exam, Gon befriends three main companions: Killua Zoldyck, Kurapika, and Leorio. Each of them has their own goals, such as escaping an assassin family, avenging a fallen clan, or becoming a doctor.

Killua is the heir of the famous Zoldyck family of assassins. Although he was trained to kill from childhood, he rebels against this life and chooses Gon as his best friend, joining him on many adventures.

Kurapika is the last surviving member of the Kurta Clan, whose people were massacred for their scarlet eyes. He becomes a Hunter to track down the Phantom Troupe, the criminal group responsible for the tragedy.

Leorio at first seems interested only in money, but his true goal is to study medicine and become a doctor who can treat people for free. He hopes the Hunter License will help him pay for his education and gain influence.

One of the core power systems in Hunter × Hunter is called Nen. Nen users learn to control and shape their life energy, called aura, allowing them to strengthen their bodies, enhance senses, or create unique abilities.

Nen abilities are grouped into several categories, such as Enhancement, Emission, Manipulation, Conjuration, Transmutation, and Specialization. A user's personality often influences which category they are strongest in.

The series is divided into several major story arcs, including the Hunter Exam, Heavens Arena, Yorknew City, Greed Island, Chimera Ant, and the Election arc, followed by the ongoing Dark Continent-related storyline.
Hunter × Hunter has received two main anime adaptations. The first was produced by Nippon Animation from 1999 to 2001 and was followed by several original video animations that continued the story.
A second anime series produced by Madhouse aired from 2011 to 2014. This version retold the story from the beginning and adapted the manga up through the Election arc, totaling 148 episodes.

The franchise has expanded beyond manga and anime into movies, video games, stage plays, and musicals. Two animated films were released in 2013, adding original stories set in the Hunter × Hunter universe.

Hunter × Hunter is widely praised for its strategic battles, complex power system, and morally gray characters. The Chimera Ant arc in particular is often cited as one of the strongest story arcs in modern shonen anime.

The manga has sold tens of millions of copies worldwide and is considered one of Shueisha's best-selling series. It frequently ranks high in popularity polls and appears on lists of the greatest manga and anime of all time.
Despite the many hiatuses, fans remain very loyal to the series. Each time new chapters are announced, there is a surge of excitement online, and new printings of the volumes often see strong sales.

The world of Hunter × Hunter includes many unique locations, such as Whale Island, Heaven's Arena, Yorknew City, Greed Island, and the Chimera Ant kingdom in the NGL. Each setting has its own rules and atmosphere.

Themes explored in Hunter × Hunter include friendship, ambition, moral ambiguity, and the cost of power. Characters often face difficult ethical choices, and even villains are given complex motivations.
Gon himself is not a typical perfect hero; his determination sometimes turns into obsession, leading to dark consequences. This makes his character arc one of the most memorable aspects of the story.
Ging Freecss is Gon's father and a legendary Hunter known for his intelligence, curiosity, and mysterious personality.
The Hunter Exam is held annually and is known for its high mortality rate and extreme difficulty.
Hisoka is a magician-like fighter who enjoys battling strong opponents and becomes both an ally and enemy to Gon and Killua.
The Phantom Troupe is a criminal organization composed of highly skilled Nen users, also known as the Spiders.
Chrollo Lucilfer is the leader of the Phantom Troupe and possesses the ability to steal Nen abilities from others.
The Kurta Clan's scarlet eyes are considered one of the most beautiful treasures in the world when glowing with emotion.
Wing is a Nen teacher who first introduces Gon and Killua to the basics of Nen in Heavens Arena.
Heavens Arena is a massive fighting tower where fighters compete to climb floors and earn prize money.
Greed Island is a real Nen-based video game created by powerful Hunters that takes place in a real physical location.
Biscuit Krueger is a master Nen user who disguises herself as a young girl and trains Gon and Killua in Greed Island.
The Bomber, Genthru, is the main antagonist of the Greed Island arc and can cause explosions using his Nen ability.
Nen's Four Major Principles include Ten, Zetsu, Ren, and Hatsu, forming the foundation of Nen mastery.
Enhancers tend to be honest and straightforward, excelling at strengthening their physical abilities.
Transmuters can change the qualities of their aura, often reflecting their personalities' uniqueness or unpredictability.
Emitters specialize in projecting their aura away from their bodies, often used for ranged attacks.
Manipulators control objects or living beings with their Nen, often requiring conditions or restrictions.
Conjurers create objects out of aura, often related to trauma or deep emotional experiences.
Specialists have unique abilities that don't fit into the standard Nen categories, often rare and powerful.
The Yorknew City arc centers around Kurapika's pursuit of the Phantom Troupe to retrieve the stolen scarlet eyes.
Neon Nostrade possesses the ability to tell the future through her fortune-telling Nen ability, Lovely Ghostwriter.
Machi is a member of the Phantom Troupe known for her thread-based Nen ability.
Uvogin is a physically powerful Enhancer in the Phantom Troupe who battles Kurapika in Yorknew City.
Shalnark is a Manipulator in the Phantom Troupe who uses a phone-like device to control others.
Feitan is a Troupe member skilled in torture and possesses a brutal ability called Pain Packer.
Gon and Killua first learn advanced Nen techniques through Wing and later through Biscuit Krueger.
Greed Island cards are categorized by rarity and used to complete the game's objectives and quests.
The Chimera Ant Queen arrives in the NGL and begins consuming life forms to produce powerful offspring.
Meruem is the King of the Chimera Ants and possesses overwhelming strength and intelligence.
Komugi is a blind girl who excels at the board game Gungi and forms a deep bond with Meruem.
Netero, the Chairman of the Hunter Association, is one of the strongest Nen users in history.
The Royal Guards—Neferpitou, Shaiapouf, and Menthuthuyoupi—serve Meruem with absolute loyalty.
Neferpitou awakens Nen and demonstrates frightening power during their first confrontation with Kite.
Killua removes a needle implanted by Illumi that had been controlling his fear and decisions.
Knuckle and Shoot are Hunters sent to confront Gon and Killua during the Chimera Ant mission.
Gon's resolve becomes dangerously obsessive after Kite's death, altering his mental state.
Gon's transformation during the Chimera Ant arc sacrifices his future potential in exchange for overwhelming power.
The Rose bomb is a weapon used against Meruem, leaving a devastating effect enhanced further by Nen.
After Meruem returns, Shaiapouf and Youpi sacrifice themselves to heal him, poisoning him in the process.
Gon and Meruem never directly fight, unlike typical shonen protagonists and antagonists.
The Election arc begins after Netero's death, prompting the selection of a new Chairman.
Pariston Hill is elected as the 13th Chairman of the Hunter Association after a complex voting process.
Leorio gains popularity during the election after punching Ging on stage, impressing many Hunters.
Killua reveals his sister Alluka possesses a mysterious ability that can grant wishes with deadly consequences.
Nanika, the entity within Alluka, has powers believed to originate from the Dark Continent.
The Dark Continent is an unexplored, dangerous land beyond the known world.
Beyond Netero, son of Netero, leads an expedition to the Dark Continent.
Kurapika becomes a bodyguard for the Kakin princes during the Succession War.
The Succession War involves multiple princes competing for the Kakin throne through deadly conflict.
Woble and Queen Oito are assigned to Kurapika's protection during the Succession War.
Nen Beasts are manifestations of each prince's aura in the Succession War arc.
Hisoka declares a personal vendetta to hunt down and kill every member of the Phantom Troupe.
Chrollo and Hisoka battle in Heaven's Arena, resulting in Hisoka's brutal defeat and revival.
Hisoka, after reviving, kills several Phantom Troupe members in retaliation.
Illumi and Hisoka temporarily cooperate due to shared interests despite mutual mistrust.
Kite is reborn as a Chimera Ant after being killed and reincarnated by the Queen.
Palm Siberia becomes a Chimera Ant soldier but retains her humanity through transformation.
Morel and Knov are Hunters who play key roles in the infiltration mission against the Chimera Ants.
The Hunter Association issues star ranks, such as Single-Star, Double-Star, and Triple-Star Hunters.
The Zoldyck family lives on Kukuroo Mountain and runs a feared assassination business.
Silva Zoldyck is Killua's father and head of the Zoldyck family.
Zeno Zoldyck is Killua's grandfather and a respected assassin with mastery over Nen.
Illumi Zoldyck is Killua's eldest brother and a skilled Manipulator who implants needles into others.
Alluka is Killua's younger sibling with a mysterious dual personality connected to Nanika.
Milluki Zoldyck is Killua's brother who specializes in technology and gaming rather than assassination.
Kalluto Zoldyck is the youngest sibling and joins the Phantom Troupe during the Succession War.
The Hunter Exam has multiple phases, including endurance challenges, cooking tests, and survival tasks.
Satotz is the first examiner in Gon's Hunter Exam and leads candidates through a long-running test.
Buhara and Menchi serve as examiners for the cooking phase of the Hunter Exam.
Hanzo is a skilled ninja who fights Gon in the final phase of the Hunter Exam.
Killua fails the Hunter Exam after killing another examinee under the influence of Illumi's conditioning.
The Badge Hunting test in the Exam requires candidates to steal numbered badges from specific targets.
Gon's first success in the exam is stealing Hisoka's badge using a fishing rod and strategy.
The 1999 anime adaptation diverges in pacing and tone from the 2011 adaptation.
The 2011 anime is praised for its animation quality and faithful pacing to the manga.
Hunter × Hunter has inspired multiple video games based on its characters and story arcs.
Two theatrical films, Phantom Rouge and The Last Mission, were released in 2013 with original stories.
Hunter × Hunter features morally complex characters, often blurring the lines between good and evil.
The story frequently emphasizes strategy and psychological warfare over brute strength.
Nen abilities often become stronger when bound by limitations or self-imposed conditions.
Gon and Killua's friendship is one of the emotional cores of the story, influencing major decisions.
Hisoka rates people based on their potential strength, often pursuing those he finds interesting.
Kurapika develops Chain Jail specifically to restrain members of the Phantom Troupe.
Kurapika's Emperor Time allows him to access all Nen categories flawlessly at the cost of his lifespan.
The Hunter Association regulates Hunters and assigns missions such as exploration, investigation, and law enforcement.
